messages:
Maya K: Customer asked if we can do a fully air-gapped POC with physical media handoff. Key asks: DB migration approach, signed bundles, and a quote for 6-week engagement.
Deepak P: Quick notes: for no-network sites we prepare an offline installer bundle + SBOM + detached signature. They verify with the public key we provide.
Rae (sales): Procurement wants pricing: flat POC fee + daily engineering hours. Also they want an optional on-prem day for activation.
Sam L: DB migration options: full base backup transfer via encrypted disk, then apply WALs delivered in last handoff. If WALs are large, final replay could take hours. For a 2TB DB expect 1-3 hours, for 8TB expect 4-10 hours depending on I/O of target.
Maya K: They explicitly cannot accept any inbound connections for validation. So our test validations must run locally by their team using our verification checklist.
Deepak P: Add chunked bundles: our installer supports chunk hashes + resume. We'll include a manifest and a signer for each chunk so they can verify integrity during import.
Rae (sales): Legal/security asked about chain-of-custody and media handling. We should supply a recommended procedure (WORM labels, SHA256 manifest, signed custody receipt).
Sam L: Rollback plan: keep immutable pre-cutover snapshot. If cutover fails restore snapshot and alert. Restoration mirror time ~ same as initial restore.
Maya K: Upgrade cadence question: suggest security patches monthly (signed delta packages) and major upgrades quarterly with full bundles. For extremely locked-down customers: do quarterly full bundles only.
Deepak P: On delta patches: we can produce file-level deltas but ops teams sometimes don't permit binary patchers. If they refuse, deliver full signed bundles. Put both options in SOW with cost delta.
Rae (sales): Action items:
- Rae: confirm whether they want an onsite engineer during activation (owner: Rae)
- Deepak: draft offline-signature and SBOM verification blurb for their security questionnaire (owner: Deepak)
- Sam: produce an estimated DB cutover runbook for 2TB/8TB baselines (owner: Sam)
- Maya: append pricing appendix: POC fee, per-eng day, optional HSM advisory (owner: Maya)
deploy-bot: Build #912 produced artifacts: redwood-airgap-912.tar.gz (sha256: 3f7a9c...), awaiting detached signature.
Rae (sales): I'll include chain-of-custody template and costs in the SOW draft. Sending draft to the customer tomorrow morning.
Maya K: Also include secure-media checklist: encrypt at rest, use signed manifests, label devices, and verify checksums before mounting.
Deepak P: If they require HSM-based signing on their side, we can support an exchange process but add professional services item.
Rae (sales): Great. I'll post SOW draft here for a quick technical review once it's ready. :thumbsup:
